texts.common.a_percentage_used_only_when: A percentage. Used only when Audio Filter is threeBand.
texts.common.the_console_s_boot_rom_it_is: The console's boot ROM. It is asked for only when Load BIOS is on.
texts.common.used_only_when_audio_filter_is: Used only when Audio Filter is threeBand.
texts.error.mega_drive_cart: '%1' is a Mega Drive cartridge. Choose the Mega Drive machine for it.
texts.error.no_file: No cartridge or disc file is in the project.
texts.error.not_loaded: Genesis Plus GX could not load '%1'.
texts.error.not_mega_drive_cart: '%1' is not a Mega Drive cartridge. Choose the machine it is for.
texts.error.not_pico_cart: '%1' is not a Sega Pico cartridge (its header does not say SEGA PICO). Choose the machine it is for.
texts.error.pico_cart: '%1' is a Sega Pico cartridge. Choose the Sega Pico machine for it.
texts.firmware.cdbioseu.about: The boot ROM of the European Mega CD (128 KB).
texts.firmware.cdbioseu.label: v1.00
texts.firmware.cdbiosjp.about: The boot ROM of the Japanese Mega CD (128 KB).
texts.firmware.cdbiosjp.label: v1.00p
texts.firmware.cdbiosus.about: The boot ROM of the USA Sega CD (128 KB). It is needed to run a USA disc. The Region setting says which region a project uses, and 'autodetect' allows all three.
texts.firmware.cdbiosus.label: Model 1 v1.10
texts.firmware.mdbios.about: The Mega Drive / Genesis TMSS boot ROM (2 KB). It is asked for only when Load BIOS is on.
texts.setting.filter.about: The filter applied to the sound output.
texts.setting.forcesram.about: Gives a cartridge 64 KB of battery-backed save memory at address $200000 when it is smaller than 2 MB and its header declares none. A few games need this. BizHawk's version of this core decides it from its game database.
texts.setting.forcevdp.about: Forces the video mode to 60 Hz (NTSC) or 50 Hz (PAL), whatever the console's region is.
texts.setting.genesisfmsoundchip.about: How the FM sound chip of the Mega Drive / Genesis is emulated. The MAME choices are fast. The Nuked choices follow the chip's own timing exactly and need much more processing. YM2612 is the chip of the first console model and YM3438 the chip of later ones.
texts.setting.ggextra.about: Shows the Game Gear's extended picture area (256x192).
texts.setting.loadbios.about: Starts the machine through its BIOS ROM first (on a Genesis this shows the TMSS start-up screen). It needs the matching firmware file.
texts.setting.lowpassrange.about: How strong the low-pass filter is, as a fraction of 65536 (26214 is 40%). It is used only when Audio Filter is lowPass.
texts.setting.overscan.about: Which of the picture's borders (overscan) are drawn.
texts.setting.port1.about: What is plugged into the console's left controller port. Some games expect a particular device. Only gamepads (also through a multitap) work so far. The other devices are not supported yet.
texts.setting.port2.about: What is plugged into the console's right controller port.
texts.setting.region.about: The console's region. Many games run in several regions and behave differently in each, and some need one particular region.
texts.setting.smsfmsoundchip.about: How the FM Sound Unit of the Mark III / Master System is emulated. MAME is fast, Nuked is exact and needs much more processing, and the last choice leaves the FM unit out.
texts.setting.spritesalwaysontop.about: Always draws sprites in front of everything else.
texts.setting.systemhardware.about: Which machine this project is: a Mega Drive, a Sega CD, a Master System, a Game Gear, an SG-1000 or a Sega Pico. The choice is saved in the project and recorded in the movie, and the core never guesses it from a file name. The Sega CD takes discs. The others each take their own kind of cartridge; a Pico cartridge says so in its header, and the core refuses one that does not match the machine.
texts.setting.usesixbutton.about: Uses six-button controllers instead of three-button ones for every ordinary gamepad. Some games do not work properly with six-button controllers.
texts.slot.cart_md.help: The Mega Drive / Genesis cartridge ROM. A cartridge for another console is refused, because the project decides the machine and the file does not.
texts.slot.cart_pico.help: The Sega Pico cartridge ROM. A Pico cartridge says SEGA PICO in its header; a cartridge that does not is refused, because the project decides the machine and the file does not.
texts.slot.cd.help: Sega CD / Mega CD disc images. Each is a .cue file, whose track files join the project automatically, or a raw single-track dump (.iso or .bin). The first disc is in the drive when the machine starts. The order here is the order the Previous Disk and Next Disk inputs go through. The CD BIOS of the matching region is needed and is asked for on the firmware page.
